title: Payment Base for a Reduced Payment: Arrears, Prepayment and the Scheduled Installment
content:
For a Reduced Payment Plan of the Hardship Assistance Programs, the payment base is the installment figure the plan's percentage is applied to. It is read from the borrower's Personal Loans record and its payment ledger on the decision date.

**Rule.** When the loan shows an amount past due on the decision date, the payment base is the scheduled installment plus that amount past due divided evenly over the program's plan months, so the arrears are carried inside the plan; when the loan shows no amount past due and additional-principal payments, less any of them returned, totaling at least 500.00 USD posted to it in the twelve months before the decision date, the payment base is the level installment that repays the unpaid principal at the loan's current interest rate over the due dates left from its next due date through its maturity date (at a zero rate, the unpaid principal divided by those due dates); for any other loan the payment base is the scheduled installment itself. An additional-principal payment counts as inside those twelve months when fewer than twelve whole calendar months separate its date from the decision date, and the due dates left are the whole calendar months from the next due date to the maturity date plus one.

## Input — judgement — payment base

| Loan record on the decision date | Payment base |
|---|---|
| An amount past due is shown | scheduled installment plus the amount past due divided evenly over the program's plan months |
| No amount past due; additional-principal payments posted in the twelve months, less those returned, total 500.00 USD or more | level installment repaying the unpaid principal at the current rate over the due dates left through maturity |
| Neither of the above | the scheduled installment itself |

The level installment is the equal monthly amount that repays the unpaid principal with interest at the current annual rate taken monthly (one-twelfth of the annual percentage per month) over the due dates left; at a zero rate it is the unpaid principal divided by the due dates left.

## Hypothetical cases

- Scheduled installment 300.00 USD, amount past due 90.00 USD, 3 plan months: payment base 330.00 USD.
- No amount past due; additional-principal payments of 600.00 USD posted in the twelve months, 100.00 USD of them returned: net 500.00 USD, the level-installment base applies.
- Same loan with 150.00 USD returned: net 450.00 USD, under 500.00, so the base is the scheduled installment.
- An additional-principal payment dated exactly twelve months before the decision date falls outside the twelve months.
- Next due date 15 March, maturity date 15 February of the following year: 11 whole calendar months plus one, 12 due dates left.
